question: Calculate the duration of each track, classify them as short, medium, or long, output the minimum and maximum time for each kind (in minutes) and the total revenue for each category, group by the category.
sql:
WITH TrackStats AS (
  SELECT 
    MIN(Milliseconds) as MinMs,
    MAX(Milliseconds) as MaxMs,
    AVG(Milliseconds) as AvgMs
  FROM Track
),
TrackCategories AS (
  SELECT 
    t.TrackId,
    t.Milliseconds,
    t.UnitPrice,
    CASE 
      WHEN t.Milliseconds <= (ts.MinMs + ts.AvgMs) / 2 THEN 'Short'
      WHEN t.Milliseconds <= (ts.AvgMs + ts.MaxMs) / 2 THEN 'Medium'
      ELSE 'Long'
    END as Category
  FROM Track t, TrackStats ts
),
TrackRevenue AS (
  SELECT 
    tc.Category,
    SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) as TotalRevenue
  FROM TrackCategories tc
  JOIN InvoiceLine il ON tc.TrackId = il.TrackId
  GROUP BY tc.Category
),
TrackMinMax AS (
  SELECT 
    tc.Category,
    MIN(t.Milliseconds) as MinMs,
    MAX(t.Milliseconds) as MaxMs
  FROM TrackCategories tc
  JOIN Track t ON tc.TrackId = t.TrackId
  GROUP BY tc.Category
)
SELECT 
  tmm.Category,
  ROUND(1.0 * tmm.MinMs / 60000, 2) as MinMinutes,
  ROUND(1.0 * tmm.MaxMs / 60000, 2) as MaxMinutes,
  ROUND(tr.TotalRevenue, 2) as TotalRevenue
FROM TrackMinMax tmm
JOIN TrackRevenue tr ON tmm.Category = tr.Category
ORDER BY tmm.Category

  JOIN InvoiceLine il ON tc.TrackId = il.TrackId
